reviewer: Codex primary agent; not an independent or blind review
method: Ordered final-atlas contact sheet and direction sheet, endpoint/loop-seam comparisons, decoded GIF timing, browser snapshots at native 192x208 on light/dark/checker stages. No continuous client playback or independent direction-classification test is claimed.

states.findings: Open eyes, blink and return; the neutral cell is identical to idle frame 0.
Right-facing gait, alternating legs, complete trailing hair and tail.
Left-facing gait with gathered and extended legs; crouched passing poses remain smaller rather than enlarged.
Resting hand, raised hand, smiling wave and lowered return.
Crouch, lift, raised-arm apex, descent and landing; registration preserves a maximum 28 pixel foot lift.
Downcast eyes and gathered hands, lowered head, recovery and a small encouraging gesture.
Open palms, expectant tilt and clasped hands convey waiting for input.
Hand near chin and small head movements express stationary thinking, distinct from movement.
Hands behind, sideways inspection, lowered head and pleased nod.
Up, right, down and left cardinals and clockwise quadrant progression are readable. Nearby directions are subtle, especially 45/67.5, 90/112.5 and 202.5/225 degrees.

characterConsistency: Blue gradient long hair, blue eyes, fin ears, whale tail, navy/white maid dress, apron and headband remain recognizable across all frames.
edgeAndAlpha: No visible clipped tails, hair, hands or shoes in final cells; no conspicuous matte rim on reviewed light/dark/checker previews.
loopReview: Compared ordered frame sequences including last-to-first transitions; identity and silhouette remain consistent. Movement rows contain intentional crouch/bob variation.
warnings: Intermediate look directions are approximate visual cues, not metrically exact head rotations; neighboring directions can look similar at native size.
Browser playback was checked using sampled screenshots and controls, not a recorded continuous cycle of every animation.
Codex desktop runtime was not directly observed and the user selection was not changed.
